definitions.explanation: Eyeglasses worn to correct vision or for protection.

examples.japanese: {眼鏡|めがね}をかけています。
{眼鏡|めがね}がないと{見|み}えません。
examples.english: I can't see without my glasses.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{眼鏡|めがね}を{買|か}いました。
{眼鏡|めがね}をかけている{人|ひと}が{多|おお}いですが、{私|わたし}は{目|め}がいいのでかけていません。
examples.english: Many people wear glasses, but I have good eyesight so I don't wear them.

notes:
{眼鏡|めがね} uses the verb かける (to put on, to wear) rather than {着|き}る (for clothing). Often written in hiragana as めがね in casual contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {眼鏡|めがね}をかける: to put on/wear glasses
- {眼鏡|めがね}を{外|はず}す: to take off glasses
- {眼鏡|めがね}が{合|あ}わない: glasses don't fit/suit (prescription is wrong)
- {眼鏡|めがね}{屋|や}: optician, glasses shop

TYPES:
- {老眼鏡|ろうがんきょう}: reading glasses
- {伊達|だて}{眼鏡|めがね}: non-prescription glasses (fashion)
- サングラス: sunglasses

RELATED:
コンタクト(レンズ): contact lenses
